facts.statement: Title VII of the Civil Rights Act applies fully to algorithmic and AI-assisted hiring tools per EEOC technical guidance: an employer can face disparate-impact liability if a screening or ranking tool's outcomes disproportionately exclude a protected group, regardless of intent, unless job-relatedness and business necessity are demonstrated.
facts.source_title: EEOC AI Hiring Enforcement: What HR Teams Must Know

facts.statement: Under Illinois HB 3773 (effective 1 January 2026), an employer may not use AI in a way that has the effect of subjecting an applicant or employee to discrimination based on a protected class; any automated resume-screening or ranking feature should support human review and an audit trail of its decisions.
facts.source_title: Patchwork AI Hiring Laws Create Rising Compliance Risks for Employers

facts.statement: California regulations require employers to retain automated employment-decision data for at least 4 years and prohibit AI tools from screening out applicants based on a protected characteristic.
facts.source_title: Patchwork AI Hiring Laws Create Rising Compliance Risks for Employers

facts.statement: Before requesting a background/consumer report on an applicant, the employer must give a standalone written disclosure and obtain the applicant's written consent (FCRA); if the report contributes to an adverse hiring decision, the applicant must receive a pre-adverse-action notice with a copy of the report, then a waiting period, then a final adverse-action notice.

The candidate-facing application portal (job search, application form, assessments) should meet WCAG 2.1/2.2 Level AA so applicants with disabilities can complete the application process independently.
facts.source_title: WCAG 2.2 Accessibility Standards: Complete 2026 Compliance Guide

facts.statement: Candidate personal data (resumes, assessment results, background-check results) collected from EU, UK, or California applicants must be handled under GDPR/CCPA-consistent consent, purpose limitation, and defined retention periods.
facts.source_title: Recruitment Compliance: EEOC, GDPR, and AI Hiring Regulations Explained
